en: Black-and-white postcard showing a coastal town built amphitheatrically on a hillside beside a calm bay. Rows of white, cubic stone houses with flat or gently sloped roofs line the waterfront and climb the slope. Low clouds hang over the ridge behind the town. The sea in the foreground reflects the buildings. Greek text appears in a strip at the bottom, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is printed across the lower right.
